Overview: Latent Guardium is an EU-headquartered security analytics vendor evaluating Redwood Private (VPC) for exposing LLM-based support agents and secure document summarization. Data residency must remain in EU regions.

Key requirements (from security & infra):
- SSO/SAML: ability to ingest IdP metadata, SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows, attribute mapping (email, groups). Customer wants group->role mapping to be configurable via console or API.
- SCIM: user and group provisioning with deprovisioning events. Support for PATCH attribute updates and group membership sync cadence.
- RBAC: fine-grained console roles (admin, auditor, model-manager, infra-ops). Must support least-privilege and temporary elevation flows.
- KMS integration: AWS KMS CMKs or on-prem HSM backing. Keys never exported; Redwood must support envelope encryption and key rotation events.
- Audit logging: full control-plane audit trail shipped to customer SIEM (Splunk/ELK) over TLS; retention controls and daily digest.
- Data residency & residency attestation: control plane and model-serving logs for this tenant must be pinned to eu-west-1 region.

- Target p95 latency for conversational endpoints under 150ms for short prompts (non-batched).
